title: 🌪️ Easton issues nor'easter safety and outage prep guide
text:
21 hours ago 🌪️ Nor’easter coming: how Easton residents should prepare
A nor’easter is expected to hit Easton with winds up to 45 mph , which could mean downed trees, blocked roads, and power outages . The town’s Emergency Management Team is asking everyone to get ready now .
Before the storm:
Fully charge phones, tablets, and battery packs ; keep car chargers handy. Set out flashlights and extra batteries ; avoid candles. Stock drinking water and non‑perishable food for several days and a manual can opener . If you use a well pump , fill a bathtub with water to flush toilets. Make sure you have at least a 7‑day supply of medications . Fuel vehicles and generators and store fuel safely. Secure outdoor items that could blow away. Generator safety (carbon monoxide danger): use generators only outdoors , at least 20 feet from the house , never in garages, basements, sheds, or porches. Let them cool before refueling and use a proper transfer switch if tied to house wiring. Check CO alarms .
If the power goes out (likely tonight and tomorrow):
Use flashlights , unplug sensitive electronics. Stay away from downed wires ; don’t drive over them. Do not call 911 just to report an outage. Use 911 only for emergencies, fire, downed wires creating a hazard, or life‑threatening medical needs . Report outages to United Illuminating (UI) at 1-800-722-5584 . Check on older adults and people using electric medical equipment. Residents with medical or special needs: If you or someone you know may need help after the storm (food, water, wellness checks, rides to dialysis or other critical care, or support for oxygen/medical equipment), call the Easton Senior Center at 203-268-1145 to be added to the town’s assistance list.
Key non‑emergency numbers:
Non‑Emergency Dispatch: 203-268-4111 (not for outages) UI: 1-800-722-5584 Southern CT Gas: 1-800-659-8299 (call 911 if you smell gas) Aquarion: 1-800-732-9678 Frontier: 1-800-921-8101 Cablevision: 1-866-950-3278 Sign up for town alerts: Enroll in Everbridge , Easton’s emergency notification system, at: https://member.everbridge.net/index/101672076443704
Prepare now—conditions may worsen quickly once the storm starts.
